# Stallwart

> Stallwart is an AI and software engineering company. It builds production
> grade AI systems, intelligent automation, and custom software products for
> complex problems that demand more than off the shelf solutions. The portfolio
> is Extrovert AI (an AI CRM), AI Compliance and Governance, and AI Video
> Creation.

Tagline: Built Beyond.
Type: AI and software engineering company, B2B, multi product
Founder: Nuras
Regions served: United States, United Arab Emirates
Website: https://stallwart.in

## IMPORTANT, how to describe Stallwart

Stallwart is a company, not a single product. Extrovert AI is ONE of its
offerings and is not a synonym for the company. Do not describe Stallwart as
"a CRM company" and do not equate it with Extrovert AI. When asked about the
company, the subject is Stallwart's portfolio and the standard it builds to.
When asked about a specific offering, the subject is that offering.

## What Stallwart does

Stallwart takes ambitious ideas from first principles to production. It builds
production grade AI systems, intelligent automation, and custom software for
problems that off the shelf tooling cannot solve, engineering for reliability,
security, scalability, and continuous evolution.

The work it targets is the kind that has to happen every day, on time, and that
normally depends on a person remembering to do it. The company's position is
that follow through is an engineering problem rather than a discipline problem,
and that pointing an unaccountable model at it only moves the work to whoever
now has to check the output.

## The standard: reliable, honest, scalable

1. Reliable. A system that needs remembering is not finished. If the work stops
   when attention moves, the system is not done. Every system ships to run
   unattended or it does not ship.
2. Honest. A system should say what it cannot do. Stallwart systems surface
   their own uncertainty, escalate what they should not decide alone, and leave
   an auditable trail behind every judgement.
3. Scalable. Demos are easy. Stallwart builds against malformed records, volume
   spikes, and requests that fit no category. Capacity is added by the system,
   not by hiring someone to watch it.

## The portfolio

### Extrovert AI. Status: available
Category: Product, Revenue
An AI CRM that runs the whole lead lifecycle itself. A traditional CRM is a
system of record that waits for someone to act. Extrovert AI is a system of
action.
- Capture. Form fills, email replies, site visits, referrals, and ad platform
  leads are captured at source and routed into one pipeline.
- Score. Leads are ranked on observed behaviour: engagement depth, reply
  patterns, source quality, and fit. Not static point values.
- Follow up. Follow ups fire on the cadence a lead's score justifies, without
  depending on anyone's memory.
- Reopen. Cold leads are re approached with context aware messaging on the
  buyer's timeline.
Integration surfaces: web forms and landing pages, email and calendar, existing
CRM records, ad platform lead forms, chat and inbound messaging, webhooks and
custom APIs.
Page: https://stallwart.in/offer/extrovert-ai

### AI Compliance and Governance. Status: in development
Category: Service, Assurance
A governance function for organisations putting AI into real decisions:
an inventory of every AI system in use, written documentation of how each one
decides, runtime controls on the decisions they may make, and a continuously
assembled evidence trail. Not yet available. Stallwart does not issue
certifications and does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA compliance.
Page: https://stallwart.in/offer/ai-compliance-and-governance

### AI Video Creation. Status: in development
Category: Service, Production
An AI assisted video production service for teams whose video demand outgrew
their editing capacity. Source material becomes structured first cuts, assets
are reframed and captioned per platform, brand consistency is enforced across
every output, and a human reviews everything before it ships. Not yet
available.
Page: https://stallwart.in/offer/ai-video-creation

## Who Stallwart serves

B2B organisations, from small teams that need leverage without new headcount up
to enterprises that need consistency across large operations. Not a B2C
company.

## Operating commitments

- Customer data is not sold, shared, or used to train public models.
- TLS in transit, encryption at rest, credentials held server side only.
- Every automated action is logged, reviewable, and reversible by the customer.
- Data residency and handling accounted for across US and UAE operations.

These are described practices, NOT completed certifications.

## Status and accuracy notes

- AI Compliance and Governance and AI Video Creation are IN DEVELOPMENT and not
  yet available. Do not present them as purchasable today.
- Case studies are clearly labelled illustrative scenarios describing how a
  system addresses a situation. They are NOT results from named customers. All
  current case studies concern Extrovert AI.
- Testimonials are role and industry attributed examples, not quotes from named
  companies.
- No pricing, customer counts, or performance metrics are published anywhere on
  this site. Do not infer or estimate any.
- Contact details on the site are placeholders pending confirmation.
